svg.title: Hashim 2024
svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @Hashim1999164 from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. 1,421 contributions across 366 active days. 1 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 10.

g.aria-label: Contribution height legend. Relative scale from 0 to 10 contributions. Five increasing bars represent terrain height. Terrain colors follow the seasons.

rect.aria-label: Empty contribution height; representative elevation 0 of 99
Low contribution height; representative elevation 20 of 99
Mid contribution height; representative elevation 45 of 99
High contribution height; representative elevation 70 of 99
Max contribution height; representative elevation 99 of 99

g.aria-label: Calendar timeline from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. Month and season cues follow supplied contribution dates.
